svg.aria-label: This repo runs no service: The quick start is: get the map, check the map. check-ascii.py reads README.md and assets/ascii. check-links.sh checks README.md. Adopt the shared CI: Start with the blueprint (https://github.com/VelimirMueller/synthwerk-blueprint#readme). Run the spine locally: docker compose up in synthwerk-infra (https://github.com/VelimirMueller/synthwerk-infra#readme) starts edge, WAF, bus, database, telemetry and pulse
